title: AMD pulls a bait-and-switch on Linux users with Vivado licensing changes
summary: AMD made controversial changes to Vivado's licensing model that negatively impact Linux users, effectively performing a 'bait-and-switch' by changing terms after users committed to the platform.
problem_solved: Reports on problematic licensing changes that disadvantage Linux users of AMD's FPGA development tools.
why_valuable: Raises awareness about vendor lock-in practices and the importance of cross-platform support in professional development tools.
